product_summary: Hemant Tools Pvt. Ltd. (Mumbai, Lower Parel; branches Ahmedabad, Bangalore, Pune, Chennai, Rajkot, Coimbatore, Delhi) is a DISTRIBUTOR/IMPORTER of engineering tools, not a manufacturer. Own site (hemanttools.co.in, home + /tungaloy.html) describes it as 'prominent distributor / supplier of Engineering Tools viz. Cutting Tools, Measuring Instruments and Machine Tools Holders', 60 years in business, and lists ~40 foreign principals it represents: Tungaloy (Japan - carbide turning/grooving/milling/drilling inserts, CBN inserts, gun drills), Tool Flo, Mitutoyo (Japan - measuring instruments), Nine9, Union Materials, DHC Korea, WTO Tools (tool holders), MK Morse (USA - saw blades, hole saws), Fanar Korea, Technics, Simtek, Stanny, LMT/Fette (threading & milling), Zeus Tools, Digi-Pas (digital levels), Hepyc, Elliot Tools, JJ Tools, Copain, HC Feng, Uyar Vision, Clavis, Utilis, Mikron Tools, Unilock, Homge, ETP, MAQ, Schuessler, Noga, Original AVG, Expel, Akko, Amec, Garr Tool (USA - solid carbide end mills), Advent Tools, Filtermist, DIXI Polytool, ITP Tools, PDT Tools, Integi. Product universe therefore spans: drilling tools (twist drills, gun drills, indexable insert drills), milling cutters and end mills, threading tools (taps, dies, thread milling), reamers, saw blades/hole saws, turning and grooving inserts, tool holders and machine-tool accessories, workholding (Unilock/Homge/ETP zero-point and chucks), and metrology (Mitutoyo calipers, micrometers, gauges, Digi-Pas levels).
role_hint: trader (authorised distributor/importer of foreign brands; no manufacturing plant or own production claimed on site)
comment: Declared HS 820750 = 'tools for drilling, other than for rock drilling' (interchangeable tools for hand/machine tools). This is CORROBORATED by the site: Tungaloy indexable insert drills and gun drills, Garr Tool solid carbide drills/end mills, MK Morse hole saws - so 820750 is a genuine, correct line, but it covers only a fraction of the range. Match = PARTIAL, not wrong. Missing from the declaration: 8207 other subheadings (820740 tapping/threading - LMT/Fette taps and thread mills; 820760 boring/reaming; 820770 milling; 820780 turning; 820790 other interchangeable tools; 820730 pressing/stamping tools), 8209 inserts/plates/tips for tools (Tungaloy carbide and CBN inserts - a major part of the range), 8208 knives and cutting blades (MK Morse saw blades), 8205/8204 hand tools incl. torque wrenches (Aurous digital torque wrench launch noted on site), 8466/8467 machine-tool parts and tool holders (WTO, Unilock, Homge, ETP, Schuessler, MAQ), and 9017/9018/9031 measuring instruments (Mitutoyo, Digi-Pas) - a whole separate HS chapter (90) absent from the declaration. INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: declared industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is wrong - the company is a machine-tool / cutting-tool distribution house serving metalworking and automotive component manufacturers; it sells no metallurgical raw material and no mining equipment (no rock-drilling tools, which would be 820713/820719). TRADER SIGNS: explicit self-description as 'distributor / supplier', a portfolio of ~40 third-party brand principals, no factory, no own brand, no production capacity mentioned - consistent with trader, not manufacturer. Per project rule 1 this is a role category, not a rejection ground; per rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground either - company is retained with corrected/expanded code list. All product statements above are from the company's own website and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line was available to me in this task (customs/B-L verification is out of scope for this role). Note: the site is a 2017-vintage brochure site; the legal entity name on the site is 'Hemant Tools Pvt. Ltd.' which matches the claimed name, but I did not verify the registry record (out of scope). No revenue, CIN, PAN or shipment data researched or asserted.
